# P0 Implementation Readiness Checklist: Family Growth Garden

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned assessment of whether Feature 003 requirements, design artifacts, and
implementation tasks are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and traceable enough to begin the
deterministic P0 implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-26
**Feature**: [`specs/003-family-growth-garden/spec.md`](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on the
Feature 003 artifacts. It evaluates requirements writing, not the current application.
**Review Ownership**: Mark an item `[x]` only when an independent reviewer determines that the
requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the written requirement is ready for implementation. It does not
mean the implementation, Android build, or demo acceptance is complete.

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after an independent review confirms the requirements-quality criterion is
  satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when clarification, correction, traceability, or reviewer evaluation is
  still required.
- `$speckit-implement` reads custom-checklist state as a gate and MUST NOT modify these markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify`
  and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Record findings inline or in the reviewing command's report; a checked item never asserts that the
  app works.
